name: nonEq
title: Non-equilibrium Markov model

args.name: initialFreq
args.description: Root-state frequencies, keyed by the submodel’s state names

description:
Sets a substitution model’s root-state frequencies and normalizes its rate matrix to mean substitution rate 1 at equilibrium. Requires a rooted tree. Even a reversible rate matrix gives a directional model when the root frequencies differ from equilibrium.

Supply one frequency for every name returned by stateNames(submodel). For ordinary DNA models these are A, C, G, and T; covarion models have separate names such as OFF:A and ON:A for their hidden states.
